title: The Jordan multiplication semigroup of matrix algebras is the full endomorphism semigroup
summary: Let $\mathbb{K}$ be a field of characteristic different from $2$, and let $M_n(\mathbb{K})$ be the algebra of all $n\times n$ matrices over $\mathbb{K}$. We consider the corresponding special Jordan algebra $\mathcal{A}:=M_n(\mathbb{K})^+$ with symmetrized product $A\circ B:=(AB+BA)/2$, and write $\mathcal{A}_{\mathrm v}:=M_n(\mathbb{K})$ for the underlying $\mathbb{K}$-vector space of $\mathcal{A}$.
